title: Functions: domain and inverse
lines: | Part of f(x) | Domain needs
| log g(x) | g(x) > 0
- (f∘g)(x) = f(g(x)): apply g first; usually f∘g ≠ g∘f.
- Inverse: swap x and y, solve for y. f(x) = 2x + 3 gives f⁻¹(x) = (x − 3)/2.
- Domain of f⁻¹ = range of f. Graph of f⁻¹ = mirror of f in y = x.
- Even: f(−x) = f(x). Odd: f(−x) = −f(x).
! f⁻¹(x) is not 1/f(x).

title: Logarithms and indices
lines: - aᵐ × aⁿ = aᵐ⁺ⁿ; aᵐ ÷ aⁿ = aᵐ⁻ⁿ; (aᵐ)ⁿ = aᵐⁿ; a⁰ = 1; a⁻ⁿ = 1/aⁿ.
- log(mn) = log m + log n; log(m/n) = log m − log n; log mⁿ = n log m.
- Change of base: logₐb = log b ÷ log a, so logₐb × log_b a = 1.
- logₐ1 = 0; logₐa = 1; a^(logₐx) = x.
! log(m + n) is not log m + log n. Reject any answer that makes a log argument ≤ 0.

title: Quadratic equations
lines: - Roots: x = (−b ± √(b² − 4ac)) ÷ 2a.
- α + β = −b/a; αβ = c/a; new equation x² − (sum)x + product = 0.
| b² − 4ac | Roots
| > 0, perfect square | real, unequal, rational
| > 0, not a square | real, unequal, irrational
| = 0 | real, equal
| < 0 | complex conjugates
- α² + β² = (α + β)² − 2αβ.
- Vertex of y = ax² + bx + c at x = −b/2a: minimum if a > 0.
! Remainder of p(x) ÷ (x − a) is p(a).

title: Complex numbers and roots of unity
lines: - i² = −1, i³ = −i, i⁴ = 1: divide the power by 4 and use the remainder.
- z = a + bi: conjugate a − bi; |z| = √(a² + b²); z z̄ = |z|².
- Cube roots of 1: 1, ω, ω², with ω = (−1 + i√3)/2.
- ω³ = 1 and 1 + ω + ω² = 0, so 1 + ω = −ω².
- Fourth roots of 1: 1, −1, i, −i.
- Real coefficients: complex roots come in conjugate pairs.

title: Sequences and series
lines: |  | AP | GP
| nth term | a + (n − 1)d | arⁿ⁻¹
| Sum of n terms | (n/2)[2a + (n − 1)d] | a(1 − rⁿ)/(1 − r)
| Mean of a, b | (a + b)/2 | √(ab)
- Infinite GP: a/(1 − r), only if |r| < 1.
- HP: reciprocals in AP; harmonic mean 2ab/(a + b). A > G > H, G² = AH.
! Three terms in AP: a − d, a, a + d. In GP: a/r, a, ar.

title: Matrices and determinants
lines: - (m × n)(n × p) gives m × p; usually AB ≠ BA.
- (AB)⁻¹ = B⁻¹A⁻¹; (AB)ᵗ = BᵗAᵗ.
- |A| = 0: singular, no inverse.
- Swap two rows: sign changes. Two equal rows: 0.
- n × n: |kA| = kⁿ|A|; |adj A| = |A|ⁿ⁻¹; |AB| = |A||B|.
- Symmetric Aᵗ = A; skew-symmetric Aᵗ = −A (zero diagonal).
! For 3 × 3 with |A| = 4: |2A| = 32, not 8.

title: Permutations and combinations
lines: - n things with p alike, q alike: n!/(p! q!). LEVEL gives 30.
- Round a table: (n − 1)!; necklace: (n − 1)!/2.
- ⁿCᵣ = ⁿCₙ₋ᵣ; ⁿCᵣ + ⁿCᵣ₋₁ = ⁿ⁺¹Cᵣ.
- Diagonals of an n-gon: n(n − 3)/2.
- Probability: P(not A) = 1 − P(A); P(A or B) = P(A) + P(B) − P(A and B).
! Arrange (order matters): P. Choose (order does not matter): C.

title: Binomial theorem
lines: - (a + b)ⁿ has n + 1 terms; Tᵣ₊₁ = ⁿCᵣ aⁿ⁻ʳ bʳ.
- Sum of coefficients = 2ⁿ.
- Middle term: n even, T(n/2 + 1); n odd, two middle terms.
- Term free of x: set the power of x in Tᵣ₊₁ to zero.
- (1 + x)ⁿ = 1 + nx + n(n − 1)x²/2! + … (|x| < 1 if n is not a positive integer).
! The rth term uses ⁿCᵣ₋₁.

title: Standard trig values
lines: | θ | sin | cos | tan
| 90° (π/2) | 1 | 0 | undefined
- π rad = 180°; 1 rad ≈ 57.3°; arc l = rθ; sector ½r²θ.

title: Quadrant signs and identities
lines: Mnemonic "All Students Take Coffee": All positive in quadrant I, Sin in II, Tan in III, Cos in IV.
- sin²θ + cos²θ = 1; 1 + tan²θ = sec²θ; 1 + cot²θ = cosec²θ.
- sin(−θ) = −sin θ; cos(−θ) = cos θ.
- 90° ± θ, 270° ± θ: sin ↔ cos, tan ↔ cot.
- 180° ± θ, 360° − θ: same ratio.
- Sign always from the quadrant of the original angle.

title: Compound and multiple angles
lines: - sin(A ± B) = sin A cos B ± cos A sin B.
- cos(A ± B) = cos A cos B ∓ sin A sin B.
- tan(A ± B) = (tan A ± tan B)/(1 ∓ tan A tan B).
- sin 2A = 2 sin A cos A = 2 tan A/(1 + tan²A).
- cos 2A = 2cos²A − 1 = 1 − 2sin²A.
- tan 2A = 2 tan A/(1 − tan²A).
- sin 3A = 3 sin A − 4 sin³A; cos 3A = 4 cos³A − 3 cos A.
! cos(A + B) has a minus sign in the middle.

title: Sum and product formulas
lines: | Sum | Product
| sin C + sin D | 2 sin((C + D)/2) cos((C − D)/2)
| sin C − sin D | 2 cos((C + D)/2) sin((C − D)/2)
| cos C + cos D | 2 cos((C + D)/2) cos((C − D)/2)
| cos C − cos D | −2 sin((C + D)/2) sin((C − D)/2)
- 2 sin A cos B = sin(A + B) + sin(A − B).
- 2 cos A cos B = cos(A + B) + cos(A − B).
- 2 sin A sin B = cos(A − B) − cos(A + B).
! cos C − cos D carries a minus sign.

title: Periods and ranges
lines: | Function | Range | Period
| tan, cot | all reals | π
| sec, cosec | ≤ −1 or ≥ 1 | 2π
- sin(ax + b), cos(ax + b): period 2π/|a|; tan(ax + b): π/|a|.
- a sin x + b cos x ranges from −√(a² + b²) to √(a² + b²).
- Even: cos, sec. Odd: sin, tan, cot, cosec.
! sin²x and |sin x| have period π, not 2π.

title: Inverse trig functions
lines: | Function | Domain | Principal values
| tan⁻¹x | all reals | (−π/2, π/2)
- sin⁻¹x + cos⁻¹x = π/2; tan⁻¹x + cot⁻¹x = π/2.
- tan⁻¹x + tan⁻¹y = tan⁻¹((x + y)/(1 − xy)) if xy < 1.
- cos⁻¹(−x) = π − cos⁻¹x; sin⁻¹(−x) = −sin⁻¹x.
! sin⁻¹(sin 5π/6) = π/6, not 5π/6.

title: Trig equations
lines: | Equation | General solution (n an integer)
| sin θ = 0 | nπ
| tan θ = k | α + nπ
| cos θ = k | 2nπ ± α
| sin θ = k | nπ + (−1)ⁿα
- Factorise quadratics in sin θ or cos θ; reject values outside [−1, 1].
- Change mixed functions to one function first.
! Never cancel sin θ or cos θ from both sides: factorise, or solutions are lost.

title: Standard limits
lines: | Limit | Value
| sin x / x, x → 0 | 1
| tan x / x, x → 0 | 1
| (aˣ − 1)/x, x → 0 | ln a
| (xⁿ − aⁿ)/(x − a), x → a | naⁿ⁻¹
! Rational function as x → ∞: equal top and bottom degrees give the ratio of leading coefficients.

title: Derivatives
lines: | xⁿ | nxⁿ⁻¹ | eˣ | eˣ
| sin x | cos x | aˣ | aˣ ln a
| cos x | −sin x | ln x | 1/x
| tan x | sec²x | sin⁻¹x | 1/√(1 − x²)
| cot x | −cosec²x | cos⁻¹x | −1/√(1 − x²)
| sec x | sec x tan x | tan⁻¹x | 1/(1 + x²)
- Product (uv)′ = u′v + uv′; quotient (vu′ − uv′)/v²; chain dy/dx = (dy/du)(du/dx).
! Every "co" function (cos, cot, cosec, cos⁻¹) gets a minus sign.

title: Applications of derivatives
lines: - Tangent slope m = f′(a); normal slope −1/m.
- f′ > 0 increasing; f′ < 0 decreasing.
- Stationary point f′ = 0: f″ < 0 maximum, f″ > 0 minimum.
- Velocity v = ds/dt; acceleration a = dv/dt.
- Small change δy ≈ f′(x)δx; % error in xⁿ ≈ n × % error in x.
- Rectangle of fixed perimeter has greatest area when it is a square.
! Horizontal tangent: dy/dx = 0. Vertical tangent: dx/dy = 0.

title: Standard integrals
lines: | f(x) | ∫ f(x) dx
| 1/x | ln|x|
| eᵃˣ | eᵃˣ/a
| sin ax | −cos ax / a
| cos ax | sin ax / a
| sec²x | tan x
| 1/(a² + x²) | (1/a) tan⁻¹(x/a)
| 1/√(a² − x²) | sin⁻¹(x/a)
! Add + C. Check by differentiating the answer.

title: Integration methods
lines: - ∫ f′(x)/f(x) dx = ln|f(x)| + C.
- By parts ∫ u dv = uv − ∫ v du.
Mnemonic ILATE for choosing u: Inverse trig, Logarithmic, Algebraic, Trigonometric, Exponential (earliest letter first).
- ∫ x eˣ dx = eˣ(x − 1) + C; ∫ ln x dx = x ln x − x + C.
- ∫ sin²x dx = x/2 − (sin 2x)/4 + C.
! ∫ 1/(1 + x²) dx is tan⁻¹x, not ln(1 + x²).

title: Definite integrals and area
lines: - ∫ₐᵇ f(x) dx = F(b) − F(a); swapping limits changes the sign.
- Odd f: integral from −a to a is 0. Even f: twice the integral from 0 to a.
- Area between curves = ∫ (upper − lower) dx.
- Volume about the x-axis: π ∫ y² dx.
- dy/dx = ky gives y = Ae^(kx).
! The integral of sin x from 0 to 2π is 0, but the area is 4: split at the zeros.

title: Straight lines
lines: - Distance √((x₂ − x₁)² + (y₂ − y₁)²); midpoint ((x₁ + x₂)/2, (y₁ + y₂)/2).
- Slope m = (y₂ − y₁)/(x₂ − x₁); for ax + by + c = 0, m = −a/b.
- Forms: y = mx + c; y − y₁ = m(x − x₁); x/a + y/b = 1.
- Parallel: m₁ = m₂. Perpendicular: m₁m₂ = −1.
- Angle: tan θ = |(m₂ − m₁)/(1 + m₁m₂)|.
- Point to line: |ax₁ + by₁ + c| ÷ √(a² + b²).
- Triangle area ½|x₁(y₂ − y₃) + x₂(y₃ − y₁) + x₃(y₁ − y₂)|; zero means collinear.
! A vertical line x = k has undefined slope, not zero.

title: Circles
lines: - (x − h)² + (y − k)² = r²: centre (h, k), radius r.
- x² + y² + 2gx + 2fy + c = 0: centre (−g, −f), r = √(g² + f² − c).
- Tangent to x² + y² = r² at (x₁, y₁): xx₁ + yy₁ = r².
- y = mx + c touches x² + y² = a² when c² = a²(1 + m²).
- A line touches a circle when its distance from the centre equals r.
! Halve the x and y coefficients, then change their signs to get the centre.

title: Conic sections
lines: | Conic | Equation | c and e | Foci
| Parabola | y² = 4ax | e = 1 | (a, 0), directrix x = −a
| Ellipse | x²/a² + y²/b² = 1 | c² = a² − b², e < 1 | (±c, 0)
| Hyperbola | x²/a² − y²/b² = 1 | c² = a² + b², e > 1 | (±c, 0)
- e = c/a for ellipse and hyperbola.
- Latus rectum: parabola 4a; ellipse and hyperbola 2b²/a.
- Hyperbola asymptotes y = ±(b/a)x; rectangular hyperbola e = √2.

title: Vectors
lines: - |xi + yj + zk| = √(x² + y² + z²); unit vector v/|v|; AB = OB − OA.
- Direction cosines: their squares add to 1.
|  | Dot a·b | Cross a × b
| Result | scalar | vector
| Size | |a||b| cos θ | |a||b| sin θ
| Zero means | perpendicular | parallel
| Unit vectors | i·i = 1, i·j = 0 | i × j = k, j × i = −k
- Projection of a on b = a·b ÷ |b|; triangle area ½|a × b|.
- a·(b × c) = volume of parallelepiped; 0 means coplanar.
